notes.title: Patchnotes - 2025/01/07
notes.content:
New Things and Features
✨ You can now see the impact that placing a resource will have on other nearby resources by holding the CTRL button pressed while in the resource placement menu. It will spawn indicators using red, green, and yellow to show if the resources on that tile will decrease, increase, or do a bit of both if you place the resource.
✨ You can obtain new town hall carts to create new towns with. Those towns will not be able to create any makeshift buildings so you will have to support them with resources from your first town in their initial stages.
✨ When allies change the recipe of a building you can now see that change immediately too.
✨ When allies pause or unpause your building it'll now show that for everyone instantly.
✨ Custom category orders in recipes are now instantly synced between allied players.

Community Requests
✨ 🌿 You can now dismiss units near research tents!
✨ 🌿 Certain animals now try to slip away if you walk on top of them / try to research them.
🌿 ⚙️ Moving animals can no longer teleport through walls
🌿 Added a basic tutorial that helps you find your first important resource! (in most cases this will be branches but it depends on the biome)
🌿 🔨 Sheep that move now take their visuals with them
🌿 Resource descriptions are now shown in the resource help menu. The resource name is now also displayed at the top to make it clear which resource you're inspecting.
🌿🔨 Placed resources now influence already existing resources in the world if the placement happens close enough to those resources (as opposed to always influencing them, regardless of distance!)
🌿🔨  You no longer get an additional 100 stock points in your storage tent when the server restarts.

Balance Changes
⚖️ Nerfed the makeshift reeds gatherer by increasing the upgrade levels from [2/4/8/12] -> [3/12/28/40] for the normal reeds & [10/20] -> [20/40] for the sickles variants. Also increased the duration of the final sickles recipe by 2 & increased the amount of resources gathered by 1 for a total of 3.
⚖️ Adjusted the recipe level requirements in the makeshift stone gatherer to require much more effort.
⚖️ Increased the default town hall storage from 15 -> 25
⚖️ The Compost Basket is now harder to unlock. It requires more materials or wovenbaskets to unlock.
⚖️ Made 'Steaming Frog Legs' in the Makeshift Cooking Stone not available unless you actually have Frog Legs

System Changes
⚙️ The resource placement bonus is now % based instead of a flat number.
⚙️ Sharing everything with a player now also shares your vision
⚙️ The town hall upgrades now, once maxed out, give you a free town hall cart to spawn a new town with. This uses a new and likely temporary button in the town hall menu until we have a better way of spawning free units.

Audio changes / Updates
🎵  Lowered the volume of Red Squirrels chittering by roughly 50%
🎵 Increased the volume of Woodcocks calling, to make them easier to make out and find in the shrubbery

New resource icons
🫐 Added an icon for Makeshift Leaves Roofing
🫐 Added icons for Dead Leaves and Dead Tree leaves
🫐 Added an icon for Brushwood

Bug Fixes
🔨 fixed building errors causing a visual flicker when the turn ticked over.
🔨 Fixed the scrollbars in Building Recipes being `hidden` unintentionally. They should now be shown again whenever you can scroll down.
🔨 Fixed Long Tailed Tit Feathers not being visible in-game roughly 50% of the time.
🔨 Fixed Orange Tips Caterpillars not being visible in-game when they are on top of Garlic Mustard, because they were referred to as `catepillars`
🔨 Fixed UI windows and Recipe Windows getting offset from their previous position when taking a screenshot, or when decreasing the screen.
🔨 Dragging a screenshot-area that is partially off screen no longer has a strange offset, which caused it to immediately reappear on screen fully.
🔨 Fixed a bug that caused endless resources to spawn in super specific file configurations
🔨 Fixed a bug that caused endless resources to be influenced by resource bonuses
🔨 Fixed a bug that caused resource variations to be mistakenly considered a spawn chance in the files under spawnotherresources
🔨 Resource placement now also influences the resources on the tile that you place your resource on.
🔨 All building and unit networking now updates allied players as well as the player that owns the unit / building.
🔨 The upgrade unit button should now disappear much more consistently when walking away from a researcher tent.
🔨 Fixed a bug that caused allied player cursors not to show up when another player logged in
🔨 Fixed a bug that caused cursors not to despawn when a player logged out
🔨 Buildings properly indicate that you cannot build them in the void.
🔨 Sharing everything with a player also allows that player to select your buildings
🔨 Fixed a niche crash that occurred when unloading roads at just the right frame.
🔨 Fixed town halls causing RPC errors when you are allied with the owner
🔨 Allied town halls that you have full control over now allow you to see what's in their stock
🔨 Allied town halls that you have full control over now allow you to change the building priority
🔨 You now instantly see if an ally is emptying your building's stock instead of having to wait a turn to find out.
🔨 Blocked buildings no longer show up in the build menu.
🔨 When an allied player throws away the resources in a building it also shows this info for other players
🔨 Fixed a server crash caused by sheep walking over roads that are not theirs
🔨 Unlocking buildings without meeting their unlock requirements (yes that's a thing, not a typo) now actually causes the building to unlock for the player
🔨 Spawning near a friend no longer spawns a path & ruins
🔨 Recipe category resource entries (whoa what a mouthful) now properly update for all nearby players when an allied player changes them!
🔨 Fixed the resizing of UI windows not working properly. Resizing a window now correctly resizes the entire element again.

notes.title: Notifications and Upgrades - Patch 2024/11/29
notes.content:
New Additions
✨ Added torch resources which provide vision for 5 turns when placed in the world for the player that placed them
✨ You can now collect other player's resources if you enable the setting
✨ You can now share full control between players, allowing you to fully control the other player.
✨ Cursors can now be shared. Clicking is also synced and plays a small sound.
✨ Signatures are now stored on the server as images. As are any drawings you might create
✨ Added 130+ new resources to the townhall
✨ Added pancakes
✨ Added the ability to roast various nuts
✨ Resource placement can now require specific biomes for specific resources.
✨ Added Andisol Heap. The placeable can be crafted in the makeshift digger
✨ Added Black sand heap. The placeable can be crafted in the makeshift digger
✨ Added mud heap. The placeable can be crafted in the makeshift digger
✨ Added drifting sand heap. The placeable can be crafted in the makeshift digger
✨ Added wet sand heap. The placeable can be crafted in the makeshift digger
✨ Added coarse sand heap. The placeable can be crafted in the makeshift digger
✨ Added sand heap. The placeable can be crafted in the makeshift digger
✨ Added cut peat heap. The placeable can be crafted in the makeshift digger
✨ Added peat heap. The placeable can be crafted in the makeshift digger
✨ There is now a nice on-screen tracker showing you how close you are to upgrading your townhall
✨ Added **Bearded Tooth Mushroom** to the world.
✨ Added **Snail Slime** to the world.
✨ Added **Fatwood Torches** and **Burned Fatwood Torches**.
✨ Added a new recipe unlock notification
✨ Added **Chickweed** and **Chickweed Flowers** to the world.
✨ Added 6 new recipes to the **Forest walkers hut**
✨ Added upgraded recipes to the **makeshift digger**
✨ Added upgraded recipes to the **makeshift stone gatherer**
✨ Added placement rules to all mushrooms in the game
✨ Easy to research resources sometimes show a highlight effect if you haven't researched them yet while researching.
✨ Added a warning that shows up if you try to research something that takes more than 30 turns to research for your researcher. This value can be changed in the settings.

Balance Changes
⚖️ Resources can now only be researched if you have the research skills to do so (not levels, the right skill type)
⚖️ Added 3 new trades to the **Trader** making it easier to obtain tils from them.
⚖️ Made crafting **pot boilers** 12x as easy to do but 4x as slow.
⚖️ **Reeds** spawn slightly less reeds seeds overall. They now have a chance to spawn seeds instead of always spawning them with a larger range.
⚖️ Decreased the cost of the **Hauling Camp** from 80 -> 40 dirt.
⚖️ Snails are now a T3 research (up from T2)
⚖️ Increased the long stick drop rate from **common walnut trees** by 5 times.
⚖️ The **Rough Toolmaker** can now unlock stone tools (not rough, just stone) by finding the pamphlet or by leveling the tool knowledge high enough.

Systems Adjustments
⚙️ Sign areas are now modular and can be used anywhere 👿
⚙️ Category gains can now use the cost category name to yield a gain rather than only resources from inside the cost category (food would now be a valid entry in addition to all types of food)
⚙️ Disabled tile claim costs still being used in the game
⚙️ Living animals are now added as placeable resources to your townhall instead of stored in your stock
⚙️ Buildings can now produce a category of a placeables, giving you the right placeable object depending on the input resources.
⚙️ Townhalls now level up automatically once you have gathered enough resources. You no longer need to pay any resources.
⚙️ The **Tree Keeper** is now unlocked upon discovery of tree seeds instead of having a level requirement
⚙️ **Traders and travellers** now stay longer if you cannot collect all their resources yet. They unslot their recipe automatically when this happens.
⚙️ Increased research level modifier from 5x -> 10x

New Resources
🌱 Added **Robin Fletchlings** to the world
🌱 Added **Western Yellow Centipedes** to the world
🌱 Added Feverfew to the world
🌱 Added **Pine Resin** to the world
🌱 Added **Hardened Pine Resin** to the world

Resource art updates
🌼 Recolored **Broadleaf Plantain/Waybread** to better represent the plant, and to avoid it looking too saturated within it's surroundings.
🌼 Updated the sprite for the **Robins** and added partofs with Rock Boulder, Obsidian Boulder, Slate Deposit, Stumps
🌼 Updated the **Long-tailed tits** sprite. Gave it some additional partofs, and setup the partof better.
🌼 Added **Long Tailed Tits Feathers** to the world. They also spawn when a Long-tailed tit dies.

Community Requested Changes/Additions
🌿  You can now request to share vision with another player
🌿 You can now request to control each others units.
🌿 Doubled the size of the numbers in the resource help menu.
🌿 Units now show their actions' progression when you hover over them.

Missing / New translations
📜 Added translations for pancakes and roasted walnuts
📜 Added translations for the Makeshift Cooking Stone
📜 Added translations to the **Witch**''s secret recipes.
📜 Added all missing descriptions to the **campfire**
📜 Added descriptions to all **Makeshift Crafter** recipes.

Bug Fixes
🔨 Fixed half vision tiles not looking darker than their fully visible counterpart
🔨 Fixed being able to click on nodes inside a scrollbar, that were overlapping the scrollbars, even when they were invisible.
🔨 Fixed townhall level ups not working properly with the new scrollbars & sign areas
🔨 The sign button now properly changes your cursor to a button cursor _before_ you press the button instead of doing so afterwards xD
🔨 Fixed a bug where the workforce hud did not respect any popups when you first enter the game
🔨 Fixed clicking on a tile while the game is loading causing a crash
🔨 Loading into a world can no longer spawn new, unique, townhall stock entries.
🔨 The buttons on the left side of the screen now properly respect the settings.
🔨 Fixed a while loop issue in the unit pathing
🔨 Fixed signposts crashing the server when you pick up a townhall
🔨 Resources now always influence nearby other resources in a 15 tile circle radius. This ensures that the order in which you place resources no longer matters.
🔨 Fixed a bug that caused resources to be spawned and moved to entry -1 (when the lowest you can go is 0)
🔨 Fixed a bug that caused units to not spawn popup messages if you owned them.
🔨 Fixed a bug in the Custom Scroll Containers that caused them to turn recipes invisible if they were off your screen when a turn ticked over
🔨 You can now select traders that are owned by the world again
🔨 Fixed a crash that happened if you really quickly selected a building with a recipe before the server's data had updated it's recipe.
🔨 Added the "produces" section back to the build menu (how did this even happen???)
🔨 Fixed errors showing up in the trade menu when clicking entries without a unit.
🔨 Fixed the shadow color of the **Common Walnut** being darker than intended
🔨 The witch unlock notification now hides the text that is in front of the letter when you try to open it (so you can see what's going on)
🔨 The townhall upgrade HUD UI no longer shows checkmarks on entries that have not been completed (yet)
🔨 Fixed a crash that occured when opening the progression menu from the main menu with the display order put to rounds.
🔨 The UI no longer suggests that you can build buildings on water 💧
🔨 You can no longer pay X times as much of a resource if you don't have enough of it to pay the full cost with just that resource (aka you use a category) and the resource in question has a negative category modifier (you have to pay more of this resource than usual)
🔨⚙️  **Reeds** no longer count as 2 **makeshift roofing material**. They now count for 0.5.
🔨 Resources that claimed a tile which are removed no longer keep the tile claimed on the client.
🔨 Fixed a bug that caused buildings that produced only placeable resources not showing their collection icon in the world.
🔨 Category gathers in recipes with category gains that use category add text (change the name of the resource you get based on some hidden conditions) now properly display the amount of resource you would be getting if you gather more than one resource
🔨 The **Resource Help Menu** now properly shows which buildings create and use tools when you click on them.
🔨 Scrollbars no longer permanently cut off UI elements that spawned outside of your screen.
🔨 Trees & other resources that don't belong underwater can no longer be placed in water.
🔨 The recipe control buttons (repeat etc) now properly hide when selecting/viewing recipes.
🔨 Resource steps no longer spawn gains if an effect is changing them into placeables.
🔨 The **rough wooden watchtower** now shows the proper visual when hovering over it.
🔨 You can now select tiles behind the **rough wooden watchtower**
🔨 Centered the research level on the icon
🔨 Research now properly shows progress again in the UI
🔨 Fixed one shot recipes not having a rough paper background when the recipe was slotted in
🔨 Compost Baskets can no longer finish construction without showing the last construction sprite.
🔨 The **makeshift planter** now gives you the correct type of placeable resources (DA -> PA)
🔨 Research levels in resources that have more than 1 resource in them now use the correct level modifier (before they showed as -1 research time)
🔨 Recipes now show the correct level (they always had level + 1)

In world resource balance changes
🧩 Adjusted the **Burned Fatwood Torch** to give a tiny amount of **Pine Tar**, to differ it from other burned torches
🧩 Made the creation of **Brushlights** cost **6 Dead Leaves** as well.
🧩 Adjusted the cooking of birdeggs into omelettes in the **Makeshift Cooking Stone** to use **unfertilized** eggs only, instead of any egg. Should avoid making strange omelettes.
🧩 Made more specific rules for which flowers can be turned into **bouquets**, and which cannot.

Placeable resource updates
🧺 Added **Brushlight** and **Burned Brushlight** as basic Torches to place. *this replaces the **Makeshift Torch** as the early game torch*
